rules.description:
Detects engine control codes like `[FADE_IN_3]` that must be
preserved in the translation target.
The `{player}` placeholder must appear verbatim in target.
Warns when a single line exceeds the engine's textbox width.

Detects accidental double-spaces in the translation target.
Common after copy-paste from a PDF or web page.

Translation targets must fit within the engine's per-string
byte budget after UTF-8 encoding.

Informational: source contains a ruby annotation. The Wrapper
surfaces this in OmegaT so the translator knows to decide whether
the target also needs a ruby annotation. Does not block.

Informational: target text does not end with sentence-ending
punctuation. Reviewer should verify this is intentional.
